title: 1 Chess Speedrunner vs 3 Hunters
summary: Multiplayer 'manhunt': the creator (purple king) races across a long vertical map of several stacked boards while three friends (Red Panda, ViperKing, Franchise - each with their own king on successive boards) hunt him. Hunters capture his king to win; he wins by capturing the dragon egg at the far end. Regular and fairy pieces (nightrider, dabbaba(-rider), camel(-rider), cannon, grasshopper, Amazon, alfil, ferz, brick obstacles, nuke, bazooka, duck, a 'dog') lie on the map and can be collected into a hotbar and dropped later. Speedrunner has a 1:3 move disadvantage (each hunter moves in turn) and 5-minute clock (no increment). Game 1: Viper tries to move the nuke, which detonates and eliminates Red Panda's king; the speedrunner lost a game on time ('I've lost'), then wins a game by a nightrider jump capturing the dragon egg with seconds left. The duck only quacks and cannot move.
rules: 4 players: 1 speedrunner (purple king, first board) vs 3 hunters (Red Panda red, ViperKing green, Franchise blue), each hunter's king on a later board (0:19-0:38).
Turn order: speedrunner, then each hunter (1 move vs 3; 1:01).
Hunters win by capturing the speedrunner's king; the speedrunner wins by capturing the dragon egg at the end of the map (0:03-0:05). Hunter kings can be captured/eliminated.

Loose pieces (white, neutral) are collected into the capturer's hotbar and placed back on the board as a move (0:07); placing is only possible on the board your own king stands on (6:19 Viper crawls his king down onto Red Panda's board so he can place pieces there; 18:37).

Pieces seen: Barrelina, nightrider, dabbaba, dabbaba-rider, Alibaba rider (hops two squares orthogonally or diagonally, any distance, 3:13 + 13:47), camel, camel-rider, cannon (moves like a rook, captures by jumping one piece at any distance, 4:22/13:01), grasshopper, Amazon, alfil, ferz, bricks (capturable obstacles), nuke, bazooka, duck, a dog, Shy Guy.
Nuke: can be collected and placed; trying to move (even clicking) it detonates it, blowing up the pieces around it (8:27-8:58 eliminated Red Panda's king; 10:13 'he blew up all the pieces').
Shy Guy (SCP-096) attacks any piece that attacks it; once captured it is gone for good (2:57, 3:56-4:04).
Duck: collectible, cannot move, only quacks when clicked, blocks nothing (19:37).
win_condition: Speedrunner: capture the dragon egg. Hunters: capture the speedrunner's king.
